description: Defines the interface HealthCheckConfig for configuring health checks in the Gateway service, including nested interfaces and enums for specific configuration values.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Interface for health check configuration settings, extending BasicHealthCheckConfig.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining default configuration values for HealthCheckConfig, such as service timeout.

classes.name: ClusterRolesConfig
classes.description: Nested interface providing configuration for cluster roles health checks.

classes.name: ClusterRolesConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining default configuration values for ClusterRolesConfig, such as enabled status and expected roles.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration used for health checks of individual services.

methods.name: getClusterRolesConfig
methods.description: Returns the cluster roles configuration settings.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether health check for presence of all cluster roles is enabled.

methods.name: getExpectedClusterRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of expected cluster roles.
